summary_en.motivation: To investigate the multiaxial fatigue behavior of additively manufactured Inconel 718 at room and elevated temperatures for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: Multiaxial fatigue tests were conducted on SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 specimens under different loading paths.
summary_en.result: The material exhibited distinct fatigue life and failure mechanisms depending on temperature and loading condition.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing with comparison to existing models.

papers.title: Biocompatibility and Mechanical Properties Evaluation of Ti-6Al-4V Lattice Structures with Varying Porosities
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V is one of the popular choices for biomedical implants due to multiple advantages, such as corrosion resistance, high strength-to-weight ratio, biocompatibility, lightweight, durability, and osseointegration properties. However, Young’s modulus (E) of Ti-6Al-4V is much higher than the E of natural human bone, which may lead to stress shielding. Therefore, it is critical that we need to fabricate the implant with specific mechanical properties that can match the patient’s existing bone. With the advent of 3D printing, we now can design porous structures with the most suitable E through adjusting porosity to suit individual needs. Porous structures with various porosities were manufactured by selective laser melting (SLM). Mechanical testing was performed to show that the E of the printed samples was related to the porosities only. Based on the simulated and actual results, there are still many areas that can be improved to enhance the quality of the printed structures. Indirect cytotoxicity tests were performed to verify the biocompatibility of the porous structures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制造的多孔Ti-6Al-4V支架的力学性能与生物相容性，与用户方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing or surface roughness characterization, both of which are essential for implant longevity assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过调整孔隙率使植入体刚度匹配骨骼，降低应力遮挡效应。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制造不同孔隙率的Ti-6Al-4V多孔结构，进行压缩测试和细胞毒性实验。
summary_zh.result: 杨氏模量仅与孔隙率相关，且所有样品均具有生物相容性。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩力学测试与间接细胞毒性验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce stress shielding by tailoring implant stiffness to match natural bone through porous Ti-6Al-4V structures.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V lattice structures with varying porosities were fabricated via selective laser melting and subjected to compression tests and indirect cytotoxicity assays.
summary_en.result: Young's modulus was found to depend solely on porosity, and all porous structures exhibited biocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression testing and in vitro indirect cytotoxicity evaluation.

papers.title: <i>In Vitro</i> Corrosion Study of Selected Laser Melted WE43 Magnesium Alloy in Hank s Balanced Salt Solution
papers.abstract: Magnesium (Mg) and its alloys have been intensively investigated as potential biocompatible materials with appropriate structural, mechanical and corrosion properties for preferable orthopedic applications. Selective Laser Melting (SLM) technique was developed for the fabrication of three-dimensional components with high structural integrity at a low cost and is compatible with various materials, including biocompatible magnesium alloys. In this study, WE43 magnesium alloy samples produced by SLM technique were examined by in vitro static test in Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS) under physiological temperature conditions for six days. A hydrogen evolution method for the estimation of the corrosion rate was used. The phase composition of samples before and after the immersion test was investigated by X-ray diffraction (XRD). The surface morphology and chemical composition of the initial material and tested samples were characterized by scanning electron microscope (SEM) equipped with energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备的WE43镁合金的体外腐蚀行为，但未涉及应力遮挡、刚度匹配、疲劳或骨整合等核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no stiffness matching, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM成型WE43镁合金在模拟生理环境中的腐蚀行为
summary_zh.method: 体外静态浸泡实验，采用析氢法测腐蚀速率，SEM/XRD分析表面和相组成
summary_zh.result: 获得了腐蚀速率，表征了腐蚀后表面形貌和相组成
summary_zh.validation: 通过与文献对比的体外浸泡实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the in vitro corrosion behavior of SLM-fabricated WE43 magnesium alloy for orthopedic applications.
summary_en.method: Static immersion test in Hank's balanced salt solution with hydrogen evolution measurement, followed by SEM and XRD analysis.
summary_en.result: Corrosion rate was estimated, and the surface morphology and phase composition after immersion were characterized.
summary_en.validation: The corrosion behavior was validated through in vitro static immersion test and microstructural characterization.

papers.title: Loss of Trial Femoral Head, A Rare Intraoperative Complication During Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Case Report and Literature Review

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于全髋关节置换术中试模股骨头脱落这一罕见并发症的病例报告和文献综述，不涉及股骨假体周围的应力遮挡、微动分析或有限元建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics, and lacks any finite element analysis or patient-specific modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 报告全髋关节置换术中罕见的试模股骨头脱落并发症
summary_zh.result: 总结了发生原因、预防和处理措施

summary_en.motivation: To report a rare intraoperative complication of losing a trial femoral head during total hip arthroplasty and review the literature.
summary_en.method: Single case report combined with a literature review of similar reported cases.
summary_en.result: Identified risk factors and recommended surgical precautions to avoid this complication.
summary_en.validation: No experimental or numerical validation; only clinical case observations.
